بَهَآءٌ Beauty, or goodliness: (S, Msb, K:) beauty of aspect, of mien, or of external state or condition: (Msb:) a beautiful aspect, that excites admiration, and satisfies the eye: (TA:) and, as an attribute of God, (Msb,) greatness, or majesty. (Msb, Har p. 271.) ―
-b2- (tropical:) The froth of milk: (JK:) or the glistening of the froth of milk. (K.) ＝
-A2- As an epithet applied to a she-camel, it belongs to art. بهأ [in which it is explained]. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
